skysleylines.configuration.title: Sky's Ley Lines Settings
config.skysleylines.spacingBlocks.toolti: Sets the scale of the ley network in blocks. Crossings can cluster or leave gaps. Applies when a world first initializes its ley profile.
Sets how far a line's influence extends on either side, in blocks. Applies when a world first initializes its ley profile.
config.skysleylines.nexusRadiusBlocks.to: Sets the horizontal reach of a nexus in blocks. Applies when a world first initializes its ley profile.
Sets how far magic extends above and below the natural ground, in blocks. Applies when a world first initializes its ley profile.
config.skysleylines.fullStrengthCapacity: Sets the maximum raw-equivalent capacity of the strongest nexuses. Applies when a world first initializes its ley profile.
config.skysleylines.rechargeTicks.toolti: Sets the default full refill time in ticks when a world first initializes its ley profile. A Minecraft day is 24,000 ticks.
config.skysleylines.rechargeTicksOverrid: Enter 0 to use the saved base rate, or 1 to 1,728,000 ticks. Reopen the world to apply. Worlds using the instance server config share this setting.
config.skysleylines.defaultVisionStyle.t: Sets the appearance of operator vision and effects that use the default style. Worlds using the instance server config share this setting.
